WITH filtered_ab AS (
  SELECT abhvreg, translink, peercorr
  FROM advancedbehavior
  WHERE peercorr >= 0.149
),
matched AS (
  SELECT fab.translink, tr.ordertypedist
  FROM filtered_ab fab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = fab.translink
  WHERE tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
),
counts_by_combo AS (
  SELECT translink, ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as combo_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist
),
totals_by_ordtype AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, SUM(combo_count) as total_for_ordtype
  FROM counts_by_combo
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  cbc.translink,
  cbc.ordertypedist,
  cbc.combo_count as count,
  CAST(cbc.combo_count AS DECIMAL) / tbo.total_for_ordtype as fraction
FROM counts_by_combo cbc
JOIN totals_by_ordtype tbo ON cbc.ordertypedist = tbo.ordertypedist
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;
